methodologyNotes: Products were selected as notable over-ear headphones a buyer compares in 2026, spanning flagship ANC, prosumer wireless, and premium audiophile tiers. Primary sources were manufacturer spec pages and reputable third-party review sites (headphonecheck.com, apple.com/airpods-max/specs/, beatsbydre.com, bowerswilkins.com, beyerdynamic.com, marshall.com, expertreviews.co.uk). Many large manufacturer and retailer sites (sony.com, rtings.com, cnet.com, theverge.com, pcmag.com, bhphotovideo.com) blocked automated access during collection. Corroboration sources were used where the primary was unavailable. Spec keys are: anc (bool), driver_mm (integer, driver diameter; null where not confirmed), battery_hr (integer, rated battery life at ANC-on / default mode), bluetooth (string, version number), codecs (comma-separated list of supported BT codecs), wired_option (bool, whether a 3.5mm or USB-C audio cable for passive/wired use is included or supported), weight_g (integer, without cable unless noted), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). battery_hr uses the ANC-on rated figure where available; for products without ANC the maximum rated figure is used. priceUsd is the US launch MSRP in USD (not the current retail price, which may be higher or lower than launch). Where no US launch price could be confirmed from a credible source, priceUsd is null. accessedAt is 2026-06-15 on every source. Adversarial re-verification on 2026-06-15 corrected three records: Bowers & Wilkins Px7 S3 (release 2024-02 -> 2025-04, priceUsd 479 -> 449), Marshall Monitor III ANC (priceUsd 380 current-retail -> 349 launch MSRP), and the Sony WH-1000XM6 priceNote (widely cited launch figure is $449.99, not $349.99).
